Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.intro: Mdmak Tech is committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring the security of your personal and commercial data. This privacy policy has been prepared to explain how we collect, use, and protect your information in accordance with the Personal Data Protection Law in Saudi Arabia and global best practices.
Privacy.sec1_desc: When using the Monaqasati platform, we collect the following types of information:
Privacy.sec1_list_1: Basic Information: Name, email, job title, contact number, and Commercial Registration (CR).
Privacy.sec1_list_2: Company Data: Company information, commercial registration, procurement details, and tender data.
Privacy.sec1_list_3: Technical Data: IP address, browser type, and device information used to access the platform.
Privacy.sec2_desc: We use your data for the following purposes:
Privacy.sec2_list_1: To provide, operate, and maintain the Monaqasati platform to facilitate construction procurement.
Privacy.sec2_list_2: To improve user experience and develop new features that meet the needs of the contracting sector.
Privacy.sec2_list_3: To communicate with you regarding updates, security alerts, and technical support.
Privacy.sec2_list_4: To comply with legal and regulatory requirements in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
Privacy.sec3_desc_1: We do not sell your personal data to any third parties. Tender-related data is only shared between relevant parties (contractors and suppliers) based on the access permissions you set.
Privacy.sec3_desc_2: We use industry-leading encryption protocols (SSL/TLS) to protect your data during transmission and storage. Our servers are hosted in data centers that comply with local security requirements (e.g., National Cybersecurity Authority NCA).
Privacy.sec4_title: 4. Your Rights as a Data Subject
Privacy.sec4_desc: According to local regulations, you have the right to:
Privacy.sec4_list_1: Access and view your personal data.
Privacy.sec4_list_2: Request corrections or updates to your information.
Privacy.sec4_list_3: Request the deletion of your data (as permitted by commercial regulations).
Privacy.sec5_desc: If you have any questions about our privacy policy or how we process your data, please contact our privacy team at:
